disconfirmingEvidence: The Nov23 2022 profit forecast was below 2021.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The Nov23 report had already almost doubled the prior 2020/22 profit forecasts and expected RMB13.678bn 2021 profit followed by RMB11.372bn in 2022; COSCO had outperformed CSI300 by ~42pp over 60d.
expectations.thesisExpectation: The fresh Dec freight surge can lift 2021 earnings further, but evidence for a structurally higher 2022 path remains incomplete.
expectations.measurableGap: There is incremental near-term rate upside but insufficient proof that the whole normalized earnings path is still underpriced.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Multi-year carrier earnings path under normalized freight rates.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: 2020/21/22 profit RMB10.11/13.678/11.372bn after a major Nov23 upward revision.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Congestion/rates stay elevated longer, lifting 2021 and perhaps part of 2022.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: The elevated-rate duration must extend enough to improve 2022 normalized profit, not only Q4/2021Q1.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: 2021 is excellent but rates normalize and 2022 follows the already-lower baseline.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Q4 freight indices and 2021Q1 earnings rapidly test the near-term bridge.
